title: Identity verification
subtitle: Verify with your citizen ID card and phone number to enable the Dead Man's Switch.
locked: The Dead Man's Switch is being activated, so identity details cannot be changed.

source.QR: Scanning the QR code on the card
source.OCR: AI reading of the card photo

consent.title: Personal data processing terms
consent.purpose: Your citizen ID is used to cross-check your death certificate when an executor or legal verifier reviews it.
consent.stored: The ID number is encrypted before it is stored and only shown partially (e.g. 0792••••3456).
consent.notStored: LegacyVault does not store the card image or your full address, only your province or city.
consent.rights: You can update the details at any time before the switch is activated. Deleting your account permanently deletes this data.
consent.agree: I agree that LegacyVault processes the personal data above under Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on personal data protection.

method.title: Choose how to enter your ID details
method.hint: Scanning the QR code on the front of a chip-based card is the fastest and most accurate option.

qr.label: Scan ID QR code
qr.desc: Use your camera to scan the QR code on the front of the card.

camera.label: Take a photo
camera.desc: Photograph the front of the card with your phone.

upload.label: Upload a photo
upload.desc: Pick an existing photo of the front of the card.

manual.label: Enter manually
manual.desc: Type in the details printed on the card.

method.aiConsent: If the QR code cannot be read from the photo, I agree to send the card photo to an AI service (Google Gemini) to read it. The photo is not stored.
method.needAiConsent: No QR code was found in the photo. Tick the box to let AI read it, retake the photo with the QR code clearly visible, or enter the details manually.
method.qrFoundInPhoto: The QR code was read from the photo; nothing was sent to AI.

scan.aim: Fit the QR code in the top-right corner of the card's front inside the frame.
scan.notCitizenQr: This QR code is not the one on a citizen ID card.
scan.unsupported: This browser cannot use the camera. Use Take a photo or Upload a photo instead.
scan.denied: Camera access was not allowed. Allow the camera for this site and try again.
scan.noCamera: Could not open the camera. Use Take a photo or Upload a photo instead.

hint.QR: Read from the QR code. Check before saving.
hint.OCR: AI may misread the photo, especially accented letters. Compare carefully with your card before saving.
hint.MANUAL: Enter the details exactly as printed on the card.

phone.title: Verify your phone number

phone.sandbox: Test mode (no real SMS sent): the code is {{code}}

errors.FOREIGN: Only Vietnamese mobile numbers are supported for now.
errors.LANDLINE: Landline numbers cannot receive SMS codes. Please use a mobile number.

nameMismatch.title: Name differs from your account
nameMismatch.message: The name on the card is "{{card}}" but your account name is "{{account}}". Update your account name to match the card?

why.title: Why verify?
why.dms: The Dead Man's Switch hands over your estate when you stop checking in, so we need to be sure the account belongs to a real person.
why.deathCertificate: When a death certificate is submitted, the ID number on it is cross-checked with the one you verified.
why.encrypted: The ID number is encrypted, and each ID can be linked to only one account.
